title: Automation & Controls
desc: Manufacturing processes, assembly controls and control software developed around production needs.

items.title: Industrial & Low-Cost Automation
items.description: Automate manufacturing and assembly tasks with solutions suited to your process and budget, including low-cost automation options.

items.title: PLC & Control Software
items.description: Develop programmable logic controller (PLC) and control software for your machines and production processes. Share the operating sequence and control requirements you need.

items.title: Manufacturing Process Development
items.description: Design and develop new manufacturing processes around your component and production requirements, with engineering controls for assembly where needed.

items.title: Assembly Controls & Poka-Yoke
items.description: Develop assembly process controls and Poka-Yoke: mistake-proofing methods that help prevent or detect specific assembly errors.

title: Machines & Tooling
desc: Complete machine building, dedicated tooling and development for your component and process.

items.title: Special-Purpose & Custom Machines
items.description: Design, develop, build and assemble special-purpose and custom machines for your production task. Share the component, operation and available space to define the scope.

items.title: Press Machines
items.description: Develop press machine solutions around your component and pressing operation. Discuss the process requirements before selecting a configuration.

items.title: Mechanical Tooling & Fixtures
items.description: Design and develop mechanical tools, special assembly tools, jigs and checking fixtures to position parts and support repeatable work.

items.title: Prototyping & Sample Development
items.description: Develop prototypes and samples to help you evaluate a component or manufacturing approach before moving to the next stage.

title: Testing & Traceability
desc: Production checks, part identification and process-data traceability.

items.title: Testing Setups & EOL Machines
items.description: Design and develop testing setups and end-of-line (EOL) testing machines for production quality checks. Define what needs to be checked and the acceptance criteria for your part.

items.title: Process & Data Traceability
items.description: Record and track process parameters and production data so you can review what happened during manufacturing. Discuss which records your process needs to retain.

items.title: Barcode Scanning Systems
items.description: Use barcode scanning to identify parts and support traceability within your manufacturing process. Discuss where scans are needed and how the data will be used.

title: Electrical & Fluid Systems
desc: Panels, industrial wiring and fluid-system controls for manufacturing equipment.

items.title: Control Panels & LT / HT Panels
items.description: Design and develop process control panels and low-tension (LT) and high-tension (HT) electrical panels, including electrical control panel wiring. Share your load, supply and control requirements to define the panel scope.

items.title: Industrial Wiring & Electrical Cabling
items.description: Industrial electrical distribution board (DB) wiring, electrical cabling and associated electrical work for manufacturing setups.

items.title: Hydraulic & Pneumatic Controls
items.description: Design and develop hydraulic and pneumatic system controls for industrial equipment. Discuss the movements and operating requirements your process needs.

items.title: Pneumatic Pipelines
items.description: Pneumatic pipeline work for manufacturing setups. Share your equipment layout and connection requirements to discuss the installation scope.

title: Production & Material Handling
desc: Assembly setups, ergonomic solutions, safety provisions and material movement.

items.title: Assembly Lines & Conveyors
items.description: Set up assembly lines and conveyors with special tools and Poka-Yoke mistake-proofing provisions. Plan the setup around your assembly sequence and material flow.

items.title: Ergonomic Workstations & Safety
items.description: Develop ergonomic solutions for assembly tasks, alongside machinery safety interlocks and guarding provisions. Define operator access and application-specific safety requirements during project scoping.

items.title: Storage & Material Handling
items.description: Design and build storage racks, bins and special trolleys around your parts and shop-floor layout, with material-handling solutions for moving parts between operations.

items.title: Fabrication & Engineering Works
items.description: Fabrication and engineering work for custom equipment, supports and manufacturing setups. Share your drawing or requirement to discuss the scope.

title: Installation & Plant Support
desc: Installation, maintenance and relocation services across the equipment lifecycle.

items.title: Machine Installation & Commissioning
items.description: Installation and commissioning of new machines and production equipment. Discuss site readiness, connections and the checks needed before handover.

items.title: Annual Plant Maintenance
items.description: Annual maintenance services for plant equipment and manufacturing machinery. Share your equipment list and maintenance needs to agree the service scope.

items.title: Machine & Plant Relocation
items.description: Machine relocation and shifting of manufacturing setups. Share the existing and proposed layouts to discuss the equipment moves and site requirements.

items.title: Hoists & Jib Crane Installation
items.description: Installation and commissioning of lifting hoists and jib cranes. Discuss the equipment and site requirements before planning the work.
